sentence: This project develops theory and methods for reinforcement learning that uses deep neural networks to make decisions in problems with many states.
This project studies soft materials such as proteins, hydrogels and vesicles, using machine learning and automated experimentation platforms to understand and control their phase behavior.
This project uses artificial intelligence to analyze undergraduate coursework and transfer credits and builds a shared prototype of degree pathways.
This project builds mathematical and physical models of how mitochondrial fusion, fission and transport shape the spatial structure of mitochondrial populations.
This project acquires a system that recaptures and recondenses helium gas for a machine that measures the physical properties of materials.
This project uses machine learning and historical solar observations to reconstruct maps of solar radio emission back to 1907.
This project combines machine learning with graph signal processing to improve the resolution of satellite images using data from satellites, radars and sensors.
This project studies how mathematical conditions force objects to take a very special form, and builds better models of disease progression in Alzheimer's disease.
This project develops theory and methods to model and control soft robots and other deformable systems using finite element models and density models.
This project creates a data science course sequence on deep learning that includes hands-on work with an autonomous toy-like vehicle.
This project develops an algorithm called quantum Hamiltonian descent to solve complex optimization problems efficiently on graphics processing units and quantum devices.
This project builds open software that detects when foundation models are given data that differ from their training, across images, language and computing logs.
This project builds a search framework that uses artificial intelligence to answer vague spatial questions, such as a restaurant next to a bus stop.
This project studies how mutations in tubulin change microtubule dynamics in yeast cells and how those changes affect spindle assembly and chromosome segregation.
This project builds algorithms and software to design and analyze CRISPR experiments, using data on guide RNA on-target and off-target efficiency.
This project uses robophysical models to study how fluid forces shape the way bacteria swim, including near surfaces and near other swimming bacteria.
This project develops theory for learning from data defined on structured networks, including product complexes, graph bundles and simplicial complexes.
